page: Microsoft Azure D4pls_v7 is an ARM-based virtual machine operating under Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is provisioned with 4 dedicated 64-bit ARM (arm64) vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM allocation of 2.0 GB per core. As a member of the low-memory Dplsv7 series, the instance prioritizes processing parallelism over large per-core memory capacity.

The hardware configuration does not bundle local ephemeral storage, requiring remote block storage such as Azure Premium Storage for persistent operating system disks and data files. It features no GPU hardware acceleration and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which requires virtual network configuration or gateway routing for external access.

Because the resource profile supplies a 1:2 memory ratio on dedicated ARM silicon, it offers efficient resource utilization for applications that do not require high memory allocations per thread. Tradeoffs include the requirement for external storage throughput and compatibility with the ARM64 architecture. Appropriate workloads include containerized microservices, build agents, CI/CD pipelines, lightweight web serving, and front-end application tiers.
description: Microsoft Azure D4pls_v7 is an ARM-based virtual machine within the general-purpose Dplsv7 family, tailored for compute-oriented tasks with a reduced memory footprint. Operating on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance features 4 dedicated arm64 vCPUs paired with 8.0 GB of RAM, offering 2.0 GB of memory per core. The server includes no local ephemeral storage, relying on network-attached storage options such as Azure Premium Storage for operating system and data requirements. Hardware acceleration is not present, with zero dedicated GPUs included. The 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio makes this instance an economical choice for environments where compute density is favored over high memory capacity. Workload applications for the D4pls_v7 include containerized microservices, software build and CI/CD agents, web servers, and front-end API gateways optimized for 64-bit ARM architectures.
